correctness.rationale: The recurrence has the exact required boundary, and an induction shows every column is divisible by the claimed power of two. The induced mod-two even/odd column relations yield closed rational generating functions by formal differentiation. Binomial coefficient extraction and Lucas theorem prove the claimed digit criterion, first sharp row, exact least period and density. The checker records 195380 finite assertions through row 360; the proof, not enumeration, supports the infinite quantifiers.

value.rationale: The theorem gives a natural complete prime-adic equality classification in the canonical second-order Eulerian triangle, with sharp lower valuations in every column, first occurrences, exact least periods and densities. The dependence on Lucas binary digit containment is a substantive uniform structural insight, beyond table recomputation or routine special-case numerics.
